phase of Ariane 6, from cryogenic technology to gas supply.

Performing with impact

Air Liquide, it’s a story of essential molecules. Molecules… Pure, invisible molecules essential to
life, matter, energy.

Oxygen, Nitrogen, Helium, Argon, Hydrogen, CO2

From oxygen that heals, to nitrogen that protects, up to hydrogen that propels the future…

Our gases are at the heart of your everyday life.

Our technologies help improve our customers’ processes.

Our technologies help reduce CO2 emissions.

Our services contribute to improving quality of life.

We’re tackling the challenges of our time (Digital / Health / Energy).

Since 1902, we've been constantly innovating, in our Innovation Campuses, and demonstrating our
relevance, leveraging digital.

+5,600 dedicated employees

320 patent applications

3.5bn data points analyzed/day

We produce locally, close to our customers.

In 59 countries

We build long-term partnerships

80,000 suppliers

We serve a wide variety of sectors, from multinationals to local craftspeople, from hospitals to
your neighbor.

+2m customers

~2.3m patients

We build ecosystems and mobilize all the local players, to develop solutions for the future.

Hydrogen for industry

Hydrogen for mobility

With our Shareholders, we move forward with confidence.

~970,000 individual Shareholders

We combine financial and extra-financial performance

€26.9bn sales

€3.5bn net income

€4.2bn investment decisions

-13% in CO2 emissions (vs 2020)

## Tailored Solutions for Different Market Needs

[Talk to a Fuel Cell Expert][44]

From 70kW-360kW net power, Ballard’s heavy-duty fuel cell modules offer flexible and reliable
solutions for your transportation and power generation needs.

Powered by Ballard’s unique proton-exchange membrane (PEM) fuel cell stacks, our modules are
designed to meet the mechanical, electrical, and environmental requirements of the most demanding
applications.

#### Buses

Fuel cell electric buses are the only zero-emission technology that can directly replace diesel bus
fleets, offering the same route flexibility, fast refueling, and uncompromised performance in
challenging climates and environments. Hydrogen, as a low-carbon fuel, provides a scalable and
efficient refueling solution for bus depots.

[Learn more about Fuel Cell Buses][45]

[Fuel Cell Buses]

#### Trucks

Fuel cell electric trucks provide fleet operators with the familiar experience of diesel power while
delivering the benefits of electrification: zero tailpipe emissions, low noise and vibration, long
range, quick refueling, and no compromise on payload, ensuring maximum vehicle utilization.

[Learn more about Fuel Cell Trucks][46]

[Fuel Cell Trucks]

#### Rail

Hydrogen-powered fuel cell trains offer a cost-effective, high-performance, zero-emission
alternative to diesel trains and costly track electrification, providing a pathway to
decarbonization of train fleets.

[Learn more about Fuel Cell Rail][47]

[Fuel Cell Rail]

#### Marine

As the marine sector faces stricter emission standards for vessels, Ballard’s hydrogen fuel cells
offer a highly scalable, flexible, and reliable power source, providing zero emissions and
long-range distributed power solutions with specific marine type approvals.

[Learn more about Marine Fuel Cells][48]

[Marine Fuel Cells]

#### Stationary Power Generation

In response to electric grid constraints, disruptions and permitting restrictions, PEM fuel cells
offer a sustainable, quiet solution for stationary power generation ranging from hundreds of
kilowatts to megawatts – where reliability, low maintenance, and ability to cycle rapidly are
needed.

[Learn more about Fuel Cell in Power Generation][49]

[Fuel Cell in Power Generation]

#### Off Road & Material Handling

Productivity is crucial for many off-road and material handling applications. Zero-emission, fuel
cell-powered equipment allows operators to achieve significant economic and environmental benefits,
enhancing both efficiency and sustainability. Fuel cells also provide a path to decarbonization of
super heavy-duty off-road vehicles.

[Learn more about Fuel Cell in Off Road & Material Handling][50]

[Fuel Cell in Off Road & Material Handling]

## Tailored Solutions for Different Market Needs

[Talk to a Fuel Cell Expert][44]

From 70kW-360kW net power, Ballard’s heavy-duty fuel cell modules offer flexible and reliable
solutions for your transportation and power generation needs.

Powered by Ballard’s unique proton-exchange membrane (PEM) fuel cell stacks, our modules are
designed to meet the mechanical, electrical, and environmental requirements of the most demanding
applications.

#### Buses

Fuel cell electric buses are the only zero-emission technology that can directly replace diesel bus
fleets, offering the same route flexibility, fast refueling, and uncompromised performance in
challenging climates and environments. Hydrogen, as a low-carbon fuel, provides a scalable and
efficient refueling solution for bus depots.

[Learn more about Fuel Cell Buses][45]

[Fuel Cell Buses]

#### Trucks

Fuel cell electric trucks provide fleet operators with the familiar experience of diesel power while
delivering the benefits of electrification: zero tailpipe emissions, low noise and vibration, long
range, quick refueling, and no compromise on payload, ensuring maximum vehicle utilization.

[Learn more about Fuel Cell Trucks][46]

[Fuel Cell Trucks]

#### Rail

Hydrogen-powered fuel cell trains offer a cost-effective, high-performance, zero-emission
alternative to diesel trains and costly track electrification, providing a pathway to
decarbonization of train fleets.

[Learn more about Fuel Cell Rail][47]

[Fuel Cell Rail]

#### Marine

As the marine sector faces stricter emission standards for vessels, Ballard’s hydrogen fuel cells
offer a highly scalable, flexible, and reliable power source, providing zero emissions and
long-range distributed power solutions with specific marine type approvals.

[Learn more about Marine Fuel Cells][48]

[Marine Fuel Cells]

#### Stationary Power Generation

In response to electric grid constraints, disruptions and permitting restrictions, PEM fuel cells
offer a sustainable, quiet solution for stationary power generation ranging from hundreds of
kilowatts to megawatts – where reliability, low maintenance, and ability to cycle rapidly are
needed.

[Learn more about Fuel Cell in Power Generation][49]

[Fuel Cell in Power Generation]

#### Off Road & Material Handling

Productivity is crucial for many off-road and material handling applications. Zero-emission, fuel
cell-powered equipment allows operators to achieve significant economic and environmental benefits,
enhancing both efficiency and sustainability. Fuel cells also provide a path to decarbonization of
super heavy-duty off-road vehicles.

[Learn more about Fuel Cell in Off Road & Material Handling][50]

[Fuel Cell in Off Road & Material Handling]

FuelCell Energy is an American clean technology and manufacturing company providing large-scale,
continuous, power solutions and emissions management.

 

[Fuel cell manufacturing headquarters in Torrington, CT.]

## Fast-track Power Solutions For Data Centers

Rapidly deploy solutions that can scale to meet your demands.

[Learn More][89]

## Our technology

More than 50 years of fuel cell technology innovation and expertise.

[fuel-cell-technology-patents-1]

Patents are for FuelCell Energy, Inc., including our subsidiary Versa Power Systems, Inc.

## Energy has a bright future

Fuel cells are efficient, scalable energy platforms that deliver steady, clean baseload
power—running on natural gas, alternative fuels/biofuels, or hydrogen. They operate quietly, cut
emissions significantly compared to traditional sources, and offer combined heat and power (CHP) for
added efficiency.

At FuelCell Energy, we deploy these solutions worldwide, powering industries, utilities, campuses,
and communities while also capturing carbon and producing hydrogen—ready today and built for
tomorrow.

Reliable, affordable, and on-demand (bio)hydrogen made accessible. On-site hydrogen and industrial
gas production plants for your processes in any sector.

## Our solutions

[

### Hydrogen production

On-site hydrogen (H2) production systems with steam methane reforming (SMR) technology, the Hy.GEN®
system, or electrolysis technology with the Hy.GEN-E® system. Offering the hybrid Hy.GEN Grand®
applying an electrical reformer.
][27]
[

### Gas purification & recycling

Gas recycling and purification technologies for efficient recovery, reuse, and purification of
high-quality industrial gases. Hy.REC® for gas recycling & purification and Hy.PURE® for gas
purification.
][28]
[

### Oxygen removal

De.OXO systems with oxygen (O2) removal technology from biogas before upgrading and hydrogen from
electrolyzers for an ultra-pure gas stream.
][29]
[

### Carbon capture

Capturing CO2 from flue gases or other carbon dioxide streams to produce gaseous or liquid
(biogenic) CO2. Utilizing Vacuum Swing Adsorption (VPSA) or amine-based technology. Full range of
CO2 gases capture & liquefier plus CO2 certificates.
][30]

As hydrogen technology provider, it is our mission to provide you with hydrogen production
technology for reliable, affordable, safe, on-site and on-demand hydrogen, biohydrogen, green
hydrogen, and high-quality industrial gases to decarbonize your project.

collaboration, the customer also entered a multi-year contract for both service and maintenance with
HyGear. Atakas uses the hydrogen at their steel metallurgy plant for their high-quality galvanizing
lines and annealing furnaces. For this, a high-purity hydrogen of 99.999% (5.0 purity) is needed.

HyGear. Atakas uses the hydrogen at their steel metallurgy plant for their high-quality galvanizing
lines and annealing furnaces. For this, a high-purity hydrogen of 99.999% (5.0 purity) is needed.

Plug is driving energy independence forward by building the global hydrogen ecosystem.

## Plug's Louisiana Hydrogen Plant

Take a 3D tour of Plug's hydrogen plant in St. Gabriel, Louisiana.

[View The Tour][73]
[Plug Louisiana hydrogen plant tour]


## Produce and Liquefy Hydrogen

Plug is proud to offer its customers industry-leading electrolyzer products and affordable hydrogen,
which is quickly becoming the molecule of choice for customers both large and small.

[Learn more][74]
[2 TPD electrolyzer]


## Transport Hydrogen

Plug offers trailer solutions to transport hydrogen from production plants to users around the world
daily.

[Learn more][75]
[Transport Hydrogen]


## Store and Handle Hydrogen

Plug offers fully integrated turnkey handling systems with capacities ranging from 60 kg to 8,000 kg
per day as liquid or gas.

[Learn more][76]

Plug's hydrogen can power a spectrum of applications to help the world safely meet its environmental
goals.

## Plug is building the global hydrogen ecosystem.

Plug is driving energy independence forward by building the global hydrogen ecosystem.

Plug is the only company delivering a complete hydrogen platform, from production and liquefaction
to storage, delivery, and power generation. These are not standalone technologies. They are
integrated, end-to-end solutions designed to make hydrogen work at industrial scale across regions,
industries, and applications.

**Hydrogen fuel cells are elevating the future of material handling.**

[Learn More][79]
[stationary power]

The need for zero emission backup, intermittent, or primary power sources is becoming more critical.

**Hydrogen is making it happen.**

[Learn More][80]

## Plug is Powering the Hydrogen Revolution

Plug is powering the hydrogen revolution. Many organizations want clean energy solutions to help
them solve tough productivity and operational challenges. Hydrogen can be used in many different
applications. Plug is leading the way. Plug’s customer demand for hydrogen has grown by 10 times in
five years — nearly a 200% annual growth rate. Our clean energy solutions are solving problems for a
wide range of customers worldwide.

# Webinar

## Reducing Grid Strain and Supporting Operational Growth with Fuel Cells

Learn how hydrogen fuel cells can help facilities reduce grid strain, avoid costly upgrades, and
support growth.

[Watch On Demand][71]

# Plug is building the global hydrogen ecosystem.

Plug is driving energy independence forward by building the global hydrogen ecosystem.

[Learn More][72]
[Green hydrogen ecosystem]


## Plug's Louisiana Hydrogen Plant

Take a 3D tour of Plug's hydrogen plant in St. Gabriel, Louisiana.

[View The Tour][73]
[Plug Louisiana hydrogen plant tour]


## Produce and Liquefy Hydrogen

Plug is proud to offer its customers industry-leading electrolyzer products and affordable hydrogen,
which is quickly becoming the molecule of choice for customers both large and small.

[Learn more][74]
[2 TPD electrolyzer]


## Transport Hydrogen

Plug offers trailer solutions to transport hydrogen from production plants to users around the world
daily.

[Learn more][75]
[Transport Hydrogen]


## Store and Handle Hydrogen

Plug offers fully integrated turnkey handling systems with capacities ranging from 60 kg to 8,000 kg
per day as liquid or gas.

[Learn more][76]
[Store and Handle Hydrogen]


## Use Hydrogen

Plug's hydrogen can power a spectrum of applications to help the world safely meet its environmental
goals.

[Learn more][77]
[Forklift fuel cell]

## Plug is building the global hydrogen ecosystem.

Plug is driving energy independence forward by building the global hydrogen ecosystem.

Plug is the only company delivering a complete hydrogen platform, from production and liquefaction
to storage, delivery, and power generation. These are not standalone technologies. They are
integrated, end-to-end solutions designed to make hydrogen work at industrial scale across regions,
industries, and applications.

[MHE forklifts]

Warehouses and distribution centers are seeking alternatives to lead-acid batteries.

**Hydrogen fuel cells are elevating the future of material handling.**

[Learn More][78]
[electrolyzer decarb]

Industrial applications are working to decarbonize their operations.

**Learn how Plug makes this possible.**

[Learn More][79]
[stationary power]

The need for zero emission backup, intermittent, or primary power sources is becoming more critical.

**Hydrogen is making it happen.**

[Learn More][80]

## Plug is Powering the Hydrogen Revolution

Plug is powering the hydrogen revolution. Many organizations want clean energy solutions to help
them solve tough productivity and operational challenges. Hydrogen can be used in many different
applications. Plug is leading the way. Plug’s customer demand for hydrogen has grown by 10 times in
five years — nearly a 200% annual growth rate. Our clean energy solutions are solving problems for a
wide range of customers worldwide.

## ARC Group is a Global Investment Bank and Management Consultancy firm deeply rooted in Asia with
## a global reach.

We are specialized in bridging between the markets of Asia and those of the US and Europe.
Established in 2015, we have grown to become a global leader in SPAC and IPO advisory.

We have maintained a top-ranked position for years, consistently leading the SPAC M&A League table
in transactional value, market share, and number of transactions.

## Great Place To Work® Certified

positive workplace culture.

## Full spectrum of
## financial services

Our services span a full spectrum of financial services including, but not limited to,
**[IPOs][129], [M&A][130], [Financing][131], [Asset Management ][132]**and **[SPACs][133].** In
addition, ARC Group provides [**management consulting services**][134], specializing in addressing
the unique challenges faced by companies operating across Asian and Western markets. ARC Group
wholly owns [**ARC Group Securities LLC**][135], a U.S.-registered, FINRA-member broker-dealer with
firm commitment underwriting capabilities.

We pride ourselves in offering result-oriented services **solving clients’ challenges where others
